name: Use at least the Enterprise SKU
description: Managed domains need the Enterprise SKU to support replica sets.
rawKql:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.aad/domainservices"
| where array_length(properties.replicaSets) < 2
| project id, name, type, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId

name: Use replica sets for resiliency
description: Replica sets improve the resiliency of a managed domain.
rawKql:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.aad/domainservices"
| where sku =~ 'Standard'
| project id, name, type, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId

name: Enable stretched clusters
rawKql:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.avs/privateclouds"
| project id, name, type, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId

name: Rule upstream later dropped
description: This rule is removed from the pack in the next snapshot.
rawKql:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.web/sites"
| project id, name, type, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
